lines.text: All the dogs gather together when I blow this whistle! Wanna see?
Doodoodoo... what should I do with the dogs today?
La-dee-dah~♬... Oh, hey Trainer.
Erm, Trainer? Is there any chance you could... pet me on the head?
Wow! You came bounding over when I blew this whistle! That's awesome!
Dogs are cute, but so are you, hee hee.
Is there a chance I can go play with the dogs?
Trainer, hurry up and get over here! Let's go play with the dogs.
Wanna take a walk with me?
Wanna play catch with me? We can play using a ball or frisbee!
Where are you going? I wanna come too!
I'm the dog whisperer! Hee hee!
Wow, feels like I just ate a big bowl of kibble!
Omnomnom~♬ Omnomnom~♬
My bark is just as bad as my bite!
Wow... this is the first time I've ever gotten a gift like this.
This is awesome! I'll bring it with me every day when I go for my walks.
*Gasp* Are you sure I can keep this? Thank you, Trainer!
Dogs are great, but you're pretty cool too, Trainer.
I hope you'll join me on my walks soon. Hee hee!
It's like my feelings for you... have become thiiiissssss big.
Are we going for a walk?
Woof woof!
Moving out!
Re-ready!
I'll protect you, Trainer!
I'm a little scared, but I can do it!
Every dog has its day!
Things are going ruff...
Stop hounding me!
*Gulp* Reloading!
Trainer!
You are all barking up the wrong tree!
The leash is coming off!
Wow!
Did I do well?
Hehe! I caught it!
Ow...
Argh!
Ugh!
Trainer... I just need to rest for a while...
I won, hee hee! Do I get a treat for that?
